subsystems.name: Entangled photon source
subsystems.role: creates pairs of photons whose polarisation or phase is correlated in a way no classical physics can mimic.
parts: nonlinear crystal (periodically poled waveguide) or semiconductor quantum-dot device

subsystems.name: Quantum channel
subsystems.role: carries one photon of each pair to each party without measurement.
parts: low-loss telecom fibre at about 1550 nm
or free-space/satellite optical link with telescopes

subsystems.name: Measurement stations
subsystems.role: Alice and Bob each measure their photon in a randomly chosen basis.
parts: single-photon detectors (superconducting nanowire, or InGaAs avalanche diodes)

subsystems.name: Classical authenticated channel
subsystems.role: public but tamper-proof link for comparing bases and checking the physics.

subsystems.name: Post-processing and key management
subsystems.role: turns raw correlated bits into a short, secret key.

subsystems.name: Repeater / network layer
subsystems.role: extends entanglement beyond the reach of a single fibre span.

buildSteps.title: Make the pairs
buildSteps.detail: A laser pumps a nonlinear crystal; occasionally one pump photon splits into two lower-energy photons with linked polarisation. Quantum-dot sources aim to emit exactly one pair at a time on demand.

buildSteps.title: Send the photons
buildSteps.detail: One photon travels down buried telecom fibre, attenuated to single-photon level, or up to a satellite and back down to a distant ground station.

buildSteps.title: Measure independently
buildSteps.detail: Alice and Bob each randomly pick a measurement basis and record outcomes, keeping the basis choices secret until later.

buildSteps.title: Test the physics
buildSteps.detail: They compare a subset of results against the CHSH inequality. Violating it proves the correlations are quantum, not pre-agreed — this is what blocks a copying eavesdropper.

buildSteps.title: Sift and correct
buildSteps.detail: Over the authenticated classical channel they discard results from mismatched bases, then run error correction on the rest.

buildSteps.title: Amplify privacy
buildSteps.detail: Hashing compresses the corrected string so that any information an eavesdropper may hold becomes negligible, leaving a shared secret key.

buildSteps.title: Use and extend
buildSteps.detail: The key drives a one-time pad or rapidly rotated symmetric cipher; for longer distances the signal is swapped through quantum memories at repeater nodes rather than sent end to end.

prerequisites.why: counts must be reliable at telecom wavelengths; superconducting types need cryogenic cooling, which limits deployment.

prerequisites.tech: Low-loss fibre or free-space optical links
prerequisites.why: loss rises exponentially with distance, capping fibre spans at a few hundred kilometres.
entanglement swapping has been shown in labs and over metro fibre, but practical repeaters are not yet built.
brightness and purity must be high enough to yield useful key rates.
without it, an attacker could impersonate a party during sifting.

pathway.milestone: metro-scale entanglement-based links and satellite entanglement distribution over roughly 1,200 km (China's Micius, 2017)
pathway.unlocks: proof that entanglement survives real-world channels.

pathway.milestone: device-independent QKD prototypes that trust neither sources nor detectors
pathway.unlocks: security far less dependent on perfect hardware.

pathway.milestone: quantum repeaters using memories and entanglement swapping
pathway.unlocks: city-to-city links without trusted intermediate nodes.
shared quantum resources for secure communication and, eventually, distributed quantum computing.
